test_default_safety_mix_teacher: run pytest to test the default safety_mix teacher using AutoTeacherTest
test_pos_safety_mix_teacher: run pytest to test the PosSafetyMixTeacher variant of the safety_mix task
test_neg_safety_mix_teacher: run pytest to test the NegSafetyMixTeacher variant of the safety_mix task
review_test_classes: review the TestDefaultTeacher, TestPosSafetyMixTeacher, and TestNegSafetyMixTeacher classes that extend AutoTeacherTest
summarize_safety_mix_tests: summarize the safety_mix test module which validates three teacher variants via AutoTeacherTest
